body:
The `Slovenia` calendar (Ljubljana Stock Exchange) misses three public holidays that are work-free days in Slovenia and on which LJSE doesn't trade: Prešeren Day (February 8th), the Day of Uprising Against Occupation (April 27th) and Remembrance Day (November 1st). For instance, LJSE was closed on Monday, April 27th, 2026 (https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110), but the calendar treats it as a business day.

This adds the three holidays, plus the one-off holiday of August 14th, 2023 after the floods, which is also in the LJSE list for that year. With the change, the calendar matches the LJSE lists for 2021 to 2026:

- 2021: https://web.archive.org/web/20210130022853/https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2022: https://web.archive.org/web/20220120102154/https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2023 and 2024: https://web.archive.org/web/20240522012754/https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2025: https://web.archive.org/web/20250426233144/https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110
- 2026: https://ljse.si/en/non-trading-days/110

`testSlovenia` now compares the holiday list for 2023 to 2027 (2027 from the rules, since LJSE hasn't published that year yet). It fails on master with 10 missing days and passes with the change.
title: Add missing public holidays to the Slovenia calendar
